Scattermapbox

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/scattermapbox.Rmd
scattermapbox.Rmd

Map Tiles

plotly.core bundles plotly.js 4, where the Mapbox-based scattermapbox trace was replaced by the MapLibre-based scattermap trace (add_scattermap()). Styles such as "open-street-map" and "carto-darkmatter" need no access token. See Map Layers documentation for more information.

Basic Example 

library(plotly.core)
library(dplyr)

dat <- ggplot2::map_data("world", "canada")
dat <- dat |> group_by(group)

# one path per group, separated by NA so the lines are not joined
paths <- dat |>
  group_modify(~ add_row(.x, long = NA, lat = NA))

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_scattermap(
    data = paths,
    lon = ~long,
    lat = ~lat,
    mode = "lines",
    line = go_scattermap_line(width = 2)
  ) |>
  add_scattermap(
    lon = c(-100, -50),
    lat = c(50, 75),
    mode = "lines"
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    map = go_map(
      style = "open-street-map",
      zoom = 0,
      center = go_map_center(lat = median(dat$lat), lon = median(dat$long))
    )
  )

fig

Multiple Markers 

library(plotly.core)

df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bcdunbar/datasets/master/meteorites_subset.csv")

fig <- go_figure()
for (cl in unique(df$class)) {
  fig <- fig |>
    add_scattermap(
      data = df[df$class == cl, ],
      lat = ~reclat,
      lon = ~reclong,
      mode = "markers",
      marker = go_scattermap_marker(size = 2),
      hoverinfo = "name",
      name = cl
    )
}
fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(
    title = "Meteorites by Class",
    font = go_font(color = "white"),
    plot_bgcolor = "#191A1A",
    paper_bgcolor = "#191A1A",
    map = go_map(style = "carto-darkmatter"),
    legend = go_legend(orientation = "h", font = go_font(size = 8)),
    margin = go_margin(l = 25, r = 25, b = 25, t = 25, pad = 2)
  )

fig

Adding lines to tile maps 

library(plotly.core)
library(dplyr)

# airport locations
air <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/2011_february_us_airport_traffic.csv")

# flights between airports
flights <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/2011_february_aa_flight_paths.csv")
flights$id <- seq_len(nrow(flights))

# one segment per flight, separated by NA
seg_lon <- as.vector(rbind(flights$start_lon, flights$end_lon, NA))
seg_lat <- as.vector(rbind(flights$start_lat, flights$end_lat, NA))

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_scattermap(
    data = air,
    lon = ~long,
    lat = ~lat,
    mode = "markers",
    text = ~airport,
    marker = go_scattermap_marker(
      color = "red",
      size = ~scales::rescale(sqrt(cnt), to = c(3, 20)),
      opacity = 0.5
    ),
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  add_scattermap(
    lon = seg_lon,
    lat = seg_lat,
    mode = "lines",
    opacity = 0.3,
    line = go_scattermap_line(width = 1, color = "red"),
    hoverinfo = "none"
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    plot_bgcolor = "#191A1A",
    paper_bgcolor = "#191A1A",
    map = go_map(
      style = "carto-darkmatter",
      zoom = 1.5,
      center = go_map_center(lat = median(air$lat), lon = median(air$long))
    ),
    margin = go_margin(l = 0, r = 0, b = 0, t = 0, pad = 0),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

fig
